conceptZh: 圓滾滾的大怪獸為了查腳印把自己彈飛，越過線索撞上軟墊後倒栽進桶裡，震落的零件排成「探」，最後才發現腳印就是自己的。
object: A pastel springboard investigation station with a footprint target, padded rebound wall, catch bucket, and eleven dark-blue stroke-shaped structural pieces.
morph: The rebound impact releases eleven stroke pieces into shallow landing guides, forming 扌 on the left and 冖, 八, 木 on the right as one correctly proportioned 探.
creativeAngle: 把「探查線索」變成彈射過頭的實體笑點；怪獸最後查到自己的腳印，讓「偵探」有明確動作可看，撞擊震落的十一筆則依導槽落定位，保住字形。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D cartoon, one continuous locked frontal wide shot, warm peach background and soft even lighting. The original lead is a huge round fuzzy turquoise monster with one horn, a goofy grin, tiny feet, an oversized felt detective cap and a hinged magnifying monocle. It is confidently curious and spectacularly clumsy. Its single play apparatus combines a springboard at lower left, a raised footprint inspection target, a padded rebound wall at far right and a catch bucket below. Eleven saturated dark-blue stroke-shaped braces belong to the apparatus; shallow landing guides in the central display plane will receive them. Keep the staging spacious and the motion readable.

0.0–1.5s: The monster spots a mysterious footprint on the inspection target, squints through its monocle, then eagerly loads itself onto the springboard to investigate. Its backside bumps the release lever while it raises its paws in a solemn countdown pose. A soft accelerating drumroll accompanies three quick knee dips. At 0.7s the off-screen voice says the first “探” as the spring compresses and the blue structural pieces begin visibly loosening.

1.5–3.3s: BOING! The monster launches left to right in a huge arc, paws reaching toward the footprint. It sails straight past, eyes following the missed clue while its body keeps flying. Hold its astonished expression for a tiny airborne beat before the far-wall impact.

3.3–5.0s: A broad, soft BONK squashes the monster against the padded wall. It rebounds backward and drops headfirst into the bucket, fuzzy feet sticking out, grinning upside down. The single impact shakes all eleven blue braces free; they tumble short distances into fitted guides and settle flat into the exact Traditional Chinese glyph 探. Preserve distinct 扌 at left and 冖 above 八 above 木 at right, with correct joins, gaps and proportions. Say the second “探” at 4.6s as the last stroke lands; all movement of the glyph stops by 5.0s.

5.0–8.0s: Hold the centered, uncropped 探 perfectly still, filling about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Outside its lower-right margin, the monster peeks from the bucket, lowers its monocle over the footprint embossed on the bucket rim, then compares its own raised sole: an exact match! Say “偵探” during this visible investigation, around 6.0–7.1s. It ends with a delighted silent nod and a tiny foot wiggle, never overlapping the strokes.

Audio: warm, friendly off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin, reading exactly “探、探、偵探” (ㄊㄢˋ、ㄊㄢˋ、ㄓㄣ ㄊㄢˋ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones and short pauses. Stop after the word. Gentle spring and padded impact sounds stay below the voice. Only 探 appears as text; no subtitles, other lettering, logos, watermark, flashing or background clutter.
